ruleDefinitions.name: Potentially Suspicious Cabinet File Expansion
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the expansion or decompression of cabinet files from potentially suspicious or uncommon locations, e.g. seen in Iranian MeteorExpress related attacks

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\expand\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-F\\:.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/F\\:.*"))) AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Perflogs\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\ProgramData.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Admin\\$\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Roaming\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\C\\$\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Temporary\\ Internet.*")) OR ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Favorites\\\\.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Favourites\\\\.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Contacts\\\\.*")))) AND  NOT ((parent_process_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\Dell\\UpdateService\\ServiceShell\.exe" AND process_command_line = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\ProgramData\\\\Dell\\\\UpdateService\\\\Temp\\\\.*")))
